neighbours.label: the token ' meaning' as the start of 'meaningfully'
fire: This might allow us to meaningfully improve treatment.
I will not be able to meaningfully use it.
The program helps students engage meaningfully with the text.
We cannot meaningfully compare these two results.
Few voters could meaningfully influence the outcome.
The change did not meaningfully reduce costs.
She wanted to contribute meaningfully to the project.
None of the drugs meaningfully extended survival.
quiet: The meaning of the word is unclear.
This might allow us to greatly improve treatment.
The program helps students find meaning in the text.
We cannot fairly compare these two results.
Few voters understood the meaning of the outcome.
The change did not noticeably reduce costs.
She wanted her work on the project to have meaning.
None of the drugs significantly extended survival.

notes: Top two examples and probe: ' meaning' in meaningfully ~1.1; the standalone noun 'meaning' 0.00. Near misses include the noun 'meaning' and other adverbs.
